value.rationale: A natural, arbitrarily large complete-bipartite Mycielskian family acquires complete equivariant deformation and geometric fixed-locus descriptions under both its full side-permutation group and the balanced part-swap extension. The first fixed locus carries all ambient homotopy, whereas the second can be contractible or a sphere of lower dimension; the remaining rational homology action is explicit. These structural all-parameter symmetry facts are not the prior nonequivariant Betti count, although the underlying orbit averaging lemma is elementary.
